provenance: Real ESA Anomaly Dataset (ESA-ADB) telemetry, Mission1 lightweight channels 41-46. Kotowski et al., 'European Space Agency Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Satellite Telemetry', arXiv:2406.17826. Data: ESA Anomaly Dataset, Zenodo record 12528696, CC BY 3.0 IGO. Missions are anonymised Mission1/2/3; they are not named Sentinel anything. Resampled to 300s, forward-filled, and z-scored with the mean and standard deviation of the training window, by the training script's own preprocess(). These are 128 of the 441,600 windows in the held-out test window, the last 30 percent of the 1,472,832-step timeline, drawn at random and kept in time order; the model trained on none of them. Unlike the NASA SMAP/MSL sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline.
split: windows drawn at random from the held-out temporal test window, the last 30 percent of the resampled timeline

input.layout: samples[i] is 250 timesteps x 6 channels at 300s cadence, row-major, already resampled and z-scored

expected.note: Mean absolute error of the next-step forecast in z-score units, measured here with onnxruntime on exactly these windows as shipped. persistence_mae is what predicting no change would score, so a reader can tell whether the model is doing anything. Over all 441,600 test windows the same graph scores 0.0250 against persistence 0.0764.
